# Munder Difflin donor snapshots

This directory stores frozen, non-authoritative upstream donor material used by Global Mobility AIOS architecture and implementation work.

Current snapshot: `v0.4.4/`.

**Do not implement AIOS by editing the donor snapshot.** Treat it as read-only reference material and adapt selected capabilities into AIOS-owned modules according to `docs/MUNDER_DIFFLIN_AIOS_ADOPTION_V1.md`.
